goal: A WorkItem can be planned, gated, approved, scheduled, and controlled as a visible workflow run using built-in capabilities and a versioned default template
scenarios: inspecting a transition lists missing fields, evidence, reviews, or approvals
an invalid status change is blocked with those missing items
an override records actor, reason, scope, and an audit event
planning a WorkItem creates sequential agent steps with skills, tools, checks, and handoffs
a blocked or unapproved step does not start
a human can approve or reject a request and the decision is a role-scoped event
the run view shows owner, running and waiting steps, next action, scheduler reasons, and a timeline
authorized users can pause, resume, cancel, retry, or reassign a step
built-in capabilities and the default template can be selected or cloned but not mutated in place
customers cannot manage workflow runs or approvals
constraints: forbidden lifecycle transitions remain blocked even with override
dependent steps wait for required approvals
creating a workflow run does not create a dsh LLM chat task by itself
